chunks: Ismāʿīl ibn Jābir asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About a man who takes from his nails and his mustache: should he wipe it with water? He said: “No, he is pure.”

key_terms.أَظَافِيرِهِ: his nails, referring to trimming the nails
key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلُ: Ismāʿīl, the narrator asking the Imam
key_terms.بِالْمَاءِ: with water, meaning wiping or washing afterward
key_terms.طَهُورٌ: pure; remaining in a state of ritual purity

ai.seo_question: Does trimming the nails or mustache require washing or wiping with water afterward?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that trimming the nails and mustache does not require wiping with water afterward. It indicates that such acts do not compromise ritual purity, so the person remains in a state of taharah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.141 - Ismail ibn Jaber asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

about a man who trims his nails and mustache: should he wipe them with water afterward?
Imam (as) said: 'No, he is already pure.'.
